Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a Helm chart deploying a Postgres database for a non-production environment: StatefulSet, headless Service, PVC, Secret for credentials, and an init job to create the application database.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments)

Task: Generate a Helm chart deploying a Postgres database for a non-production environment: StatefulSet, headless Service, PVC, Secret for credentials, and an init job to create the application database.

Output only the Helm chart templates (YAML; provide Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and templates/ as separate files concatenated with '---' YAML document separators and clearly labeled '# FILE: <path>' comments) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
# FILE: Chart.yaml
name: postgres
version: 1.0.0
description: A Helm chart for deploying a Postgres database
type: application
appVersion: 14.5
dependencies:
  - name: common
    version: ^1.0.0
    repository: https://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami

# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 1
image:
  repository: postgres
  tag: 14.5
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
service:
  type: ClusterIP
  port: 5432
persistence:
  enabled: true
  size: 1Gi
postgresql:
  postgresPassword: changeme
  postgresUser: postgres
  database: mydatabase
  username: myuser
  password: changeme
initJob:
  enabled: true
  image:
    repository: postgres
    tag: 14.5
  command: ["psql", "-U", "postgres", "-c", "CREATE DATABASE mydatabase; CREATE ROLE myuser WITH PASSWORD 'changeme'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE mydatabase TO myuser;"]

# FILE: templates/statefulset.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}
        image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
        ports:
        - name: postgres
          containerPort: 5432
          protocol: TCP
        env:
        - name: POSTGRES_USER
          value: {{ .Values.postgresql.postgresUser }}
        - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          value: {{ .Values.postgresql.postgresPassword }}
        - name: PGDATA
          value: /var/lib/postgresql/data
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-pvc

# FILE: templates/service.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
  - name: postgres
    port: 5432
    targetPort: postgres
  selector:
    app: {{ include "postgres.name" . }}

# FILE: templates/pvc.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: {{ .Values.persistence.size }}

# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-secret
type: Opaque
data:
  postgres-password: {{ .Values.postgresql.postgresPassword | b64enc }}
  postgres-username: {{ .Values.postgresql.postgresUser | b64enc }}
  database: {{ .Values.postgresql.database | b64enc }}
  username: {{ .Values.postgresql.username | b64enc }}
  password: {{ .Values.postgresql.password | b64enc }}

# FILE: templates/initjob.yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: {{ include "postgres.fullname" . }}-init
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: init
        image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
        imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
        command: {{ .Values.initJob.command }}
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
  backoffLimit: 4

# FILE: templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "postgres.name" -}}
{{ .Chart.Name }}
{{- end -}}

{{- define "postgres.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride -}}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- else -}}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
